note: This file is a MMDetection configuration file containing only dictionary literals and a base config path string. It has no functions, classes, or callable code. It configures a Grid R-CNN model with Generic RoI Extractor (GROIE) using GeneralizedAttention post-processing on both bbox and grid ROI extractors.
config_model_bbox_roi_extractor: uses GenericRoIExtractor with RoIAlign (output_size=7), ConvModule pre-processing, and GeneralizedAttention (6 heads) post-processing
config_model_grid_roi_extractor: uses GenericRoIExtractor with RoIAlign (output_size=14), ConvModule pre-processing, and GeneralizedAttention (6 heads) post-processing
run_model_training: run mmdetection training with this config: python tools/train.py configs/groie/grid-rcnn_r50_fpn_gn-head-groie_1x_coco.py
run_model_test: run mmdetection testing with this config: python tools/test.py configs/groie/grid-rcnn_r50_fpn_gn-head-groie_1x_coco.py CHECKPOINT
